# Adding "Date Last Read" to Sort Function (2026-02-03 22:55Z)

_**User (2026-02-03 23:56Z)**_

I want to add a new option to the Sort function.
I want the ability to sort by “Date Last Read”. This option when selected will first sort based on the date, latest first, that a series was read. Then if there are multiple series that have the same date the sort will then sort alphabetical A to Z.
On the drop-down Sort menu, I want to place the following text below the “Title” text.
The small text along the left vertical edge I want the numbers “12” then I want the text “Date Last Read”.
Use the same font size and color as the “Title” text. Do not include the ability to reverse the sorting direction.
Add this new option to the backup file and make sure it can be restored.
Make sure that any changes do not affect the operation of the program and do cause problems with Lint and Release actions.
